scenarios.name: Show active-tab panels from an inactive tab context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Primitives panel is hidden and the Modify panel is visible
the user right-clicks the inactive View ribbon tab
the 3D Model ribbon remains active
a ribbon context menu opens
the user opens Show Panels in the context menu
the submenu lists panels from the active 3D Model ribbon
Primitives is unchecked and Modify is checked
the 3D Model ribbon remains visible
